title: Two conjectures of Sun on the recurrence a(n+1) = 2n(n+1)a(n) - n^4 a(n-1) are false
description: Let a(0) = 1, a(1) = 0 and a(n+1) = 2n(n+1)a(n) - n^4 a(n-1) (OEIS A217703). Z.-W. Sun conjectured that a(n) < 0 exactly when 1 < n < 58 or n > 2177, and that |a(n)|^(1/n) = o(n^2). Both are false: an exact computation gives a(81935) > 0, and we prove that the limsup of |a(n)|^(1/n)/n^2 is e^(-2), using the Casoratian of the recurrence and a polynomial bound for a second solution. The disproof of the second conjecture is formalized in Lean 4 with Mathlib against the statement OeisA217703.conjecture3 of Google DeepMind's Formal Conjectures repository. The repository contains the paper (LaTeX source and PDF), the Lean files, a check script, exact computations and logs.
